mapper.update: update inventory set qty = qty + #{qty}, update_time = #{updateTime}, update_user_id = #{updateUserId}, update_user_name = #{updateUserName} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false
mapper.select:
SELECT inv.id, inv.org_id, inv.warehouse_id, inv.warehouse_location, inv.sku_id, inv.sku_no, inv.dict_inventory_status, inv.qty FROM "inventory" inv LEFT JOIN transaction_flow tf ON inv."id" = tf.inventory_id AND tf.is_deleted = FALSE AND tf.trade_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime} WHERE inv.is_deleted = false and inv.dict_inventory_status in ('usable','frozen') AND ( inv.qty > 0 OR (inv.qty = 0 AND tf.inventory_id IS NOT NULL) )
and inv.warehouse_id in
#{item.warehouseId}
and (inv.warehouse_id, inv.warehouse_location) in
(#{item.warehouseId}, #{item.warehouseLocation})
and (inv.warehouse_id, inv.warehouse_location, inv.sku_id) in
(#{item.warehouseId}, #{item.warehouseLocation}, #{item.skuId})
GROUP BY inv.id order by inv.warehouse_id, inv.warehouse_location, inv.sku_id, inv.dict_inventory_status

SELECT it.warehouse_id, it.org_id, it.sku_id, sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' then it.qty else 0 end) + sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' then it.qty else 0 end) as realQty, sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' then it.qty else 0 end) as usableQty, sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' then it.qty else 0 end) as frozenQty, sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' then it.qty else 0 end) as intransitQty, sum(case when it.dict_inventory_status = 'waitQc' then it.qty else 0 end) as waitqcQty
,MAX(it.warehouse_location) warehouseLocation
FROM "inventory" it WHERE it.is_deleted = FALSE
and it.sku_id in
(#{item})
and it.warehouse_location in
(#{item})
and it.warehouse_id = #{params.warehouseId}
and it.org_id = #{params.orgId}
GROUP BY it.warehouse_id, it.org_id, it.sku_id

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT max(m.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(m.org_id) AS org_id, max(m.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(m.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(m.product_name) AS product_name, max(m.product_img_url) AS product_img_url, max(m.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(m.sale_state) AS sale_state, sum(m.usable_qty) AS usable_qty, sum(m.frozen_qty) AS frozen_qty, sum(m.intransit_qty) AS intransit_qty, sum(m.waitqc_qty) AS waitqc_qty, sum(m.usable_qty) + sum(m.frozen_qty) AS real_qty FROM (SELECT max(it.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(it.org_id) AS org_id, max(it.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(it.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(pd.name) AS product_name, max(pd.images_url) AS product_img_url, max(pi.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(ps.sale_state) AS sale_state, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS usable_qty, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozen_qty, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'inTransit' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS intransit_qty, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'waitQc' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS waitqc_qty FROM inventory it LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pd.id = it.sku_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd.id AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE it.is_deleted = false GROUP BY it.warehouse_id, it.org_id, it.sku_id, it.dict_inventory_status) m GROUP BY m.warehouse_id, m.org_id, m.sku_id) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT max(m.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(m.org_id) AS org_id, max(m.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(m.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(m.product_name) AS product_name, max(m.product_img_url) AS product_img_url, max(m.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(m.sale_state) AS sale_state, max(m.area_code) AS area_code, sum(m.usable_qty) AS usable_qty, sum(m.frozen_qty) AS frozen_qty, sum(m.usable_qty) + sum(m.frozen_qty) AS real_qty FROM (SELECT max(it.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(it.org_id) AS org_id, max(it.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(it.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(pd.name) AS product_name, max(pd.images_url) AS product_img_url, max(pi.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(ps.sale_state) AS sale_state, max(wl.area_code) AS area_code, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS usable_qty, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozen_qty FROM inventory it LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pd.id = it.sku_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd.id AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT s.code AS location_code, wa.code AS area_code, s.warehouse_id FROM warehouse_location s LEFT JOIN warehouse_location wa ON s.parent_id = wa.id AND s.is_deleted = false AND wa.is_deleted = false) wl ON it.warehouse_location = wl.location_code AND it.warehouse_id = wl.warehouse_id WHERE it.is_deleted = false GROUP BY it.warehouse_id, it.org_id, it.sku_id, it.dict_inventory_status, wl.area_code) m GROUP BY m.warehouse_id, m.org_id, m.sku_id, m.area_code) t

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT max(m.warehouse_location) AS warehouse_location, max(m.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(m.org_id) AS org_id, max(m.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(m.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(m.product_name) AS product_name, max(m.product_img_url) AS product_img_url, max(m.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(m.sale_state) AS sale_state, sum(m.usable_qty) AS usable_qty, sum(m.frozen_qty) AS frozen_qty, sum(m.usable_qty) + sum(m.frozen_qty) AS real_qty FROM (SELECT max(it.warehouse_id) AS warehouse_id, max(it.org_id) AS org_id, max(it.sku_id) AS sku_id, max(it.sku_no) AS sku_no, max(pd.name) AS product_name, max(pd.images_url) AS product_img_url, max(pi.spu_no) AS spu_no, max(ps.sale_state) AS sale_state, max(it.warehouse_location) AS warehouse_location, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'usable' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS usable_qty, sum(CASE WHEN it.dict_inventory_status = 'frozen' THEN it.qty ELSE 0 END) AS frozen_qty FROM inventory it LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pd.id = it.sku_id AND pd.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_info pi ON pd.product_id = pi.id AND pi.is_deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN product_sale ps ON ps.sku_id = pd.id AND ps.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE it.is_deleted = false GROUP BY it.warehouse_id, it.org_id, it.sku_id, it.dict_inventory_status, it.warehouse_location) m GROUP BY m.warehouse_id, m.org_id, m.sku_id, m.warehouse_location) t
